OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized into E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped;
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise the
            '+61' country code is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from
            the national digits. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15
            digits, e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:

        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string

              readOnly: true
            initials:

              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.

              items:

          required:

      properties:

    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type

          type: string
          format: uri

          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time

          title: Schema validation errors

      required:
        - type

        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors

          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin

          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison

          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized into E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped;
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise the
            '+61' country code is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from
            the national digits. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15
            digits, e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.

          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'

## What I changed

The spec: assign `customerCode` formatted `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` where `LAST3` is the upper-cased first three letters of `lastName` and `NNNN` is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the current owner count (e.g. `SMI-0007`).

1. **`model/Owner.java`** — added a persisted `customerCode` field (`@Column(name = "customer_code")`) with getter/setter. It's persisted (not derived on read) so the sequence is captured once at creation time.

2. **DB schemas** — added the `customer_code` column to all four (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `postgres`, `mysql`) `schema.sql` files. Tests run under the `hsqldb` profile with `ddl-auto=none`, so this column had to exist in SQL.

3. **`resources/openapi.yml`** — added `customerCode` as a `readOnly` property on the `Owner` schema (alongside `displayName`/`initials`), so the generated `OwnerDto` exposes it in the `GET /api/owners/{id}` response.

4. **`rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — added a `nextCustomerCode(lastName)` helper and call it in `addOwner` before saving: `LAST3` = first ≤3 letters upper-cased, `NNNN` = `findAllOwners().size() + 1`, joined via `String.format("%s-%04d", ...)`. MapStruct auto-maps the matching `customerCode` field into the DTO, so no mapper change was needed.

The test creates `smithers` then `jones` and confirms codes start with `SMI-`/`JON-` and that the second sequence number is exactly one greater — which holds because the owner count increments by one between the two creates.
